# Mark Taylor Residential

> > Mark Taylor Residential offers luxury apartment communities with MT+ smart-home technology across Arizona and Nevada.

Mark Taylor specializes in resort-style apartment living with premium amenities, smart-home features, and pet-friendly communities throughout the Phoenix metro area, Scottsdale, Chandler, Gilbert, Mesa, Tempe, Las Vegas, and Henderson.

## Key Topics

- MT+ smart-home technology
- Luxury apartments Arizona
- Luxury apartments Nevada
- Resort-style amenities
- Pet-friendly communities
- Chandler apartments
- Scottsdale apartments
- Gilbert apartments
- Las Vegas apartments
- Henderson apartments
- SanTan Village area
- Downtown Tempe living
- Smart-home features
- Floor plans and pricing
- Premium apartment amenities

## Arizona Apartment Communities

- [Mira Santi](https://www.mark-taylor.com/apartments/az/chandler/mira-santi): Mira Santi luxury smart-home apartments in South Chandler, Arizona
- [Stone Oaks](https://www.mark-taylor.com/apartments/az/chandler/stone-oaks): Stone Oaks luxury apartments with MT+ features in Chandler, AZ
- [The Regents at Scottsdale](https://www.mark-taylor.com/apartments/az/scottsdale/regents-at-scottsdale): The Regents resort-style apartments in North Scottsdale with MT+ features
- [Azul at Spectrum](https://www.mark-taylor.com/apartments/az/gilbert/azul-at-spectrum): Azul smart-home apartments near SanTan Village in Gilbert, Arizona
- [Aviva](https://www.mark-taylor.com/apartments/az/mesa/aviva): Aviva resort-style luxury apartments near Mesa Riverview, Arizona
- [Bellagio](https://www.mark-taylor.com/apartments/az/scottsdale/bellagio): Bellagio luxury apartments with MT+ in Paradise Valley Village, Scottsdale
- [Emerson Mill Avenue](https://www.mark-taylor.com/apartments/az/tempe/emerson-mill-avenue): Emerson smart-home apartments on Mill Avenue in downtown Tempe near ASU
- [Borrego at Spectrum](https://www.mark-taylor.com/apartments/az/gilbert/borrego-at-spectrum): Borrego resort-style apartments near SanTan Village in Gilbert, AZ

## Nevada Apartment Communities

- [Shadow Hills at Lone Mountain](https://www.mark-taylor.com/apartments/nv/las-vegas/shadow-hills): Shadow Hills luxury apartments near Lone Mountain, Las Vegas, Nevada
